project_description: Make the MAS board an automatically maintained view of repository projects, approved plans and authenticated agent execution.

records.title: Define the end-to-end board contract
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Agree project identity, plan revision, task identity, authenticated agent event and evidence contracts with Antigravity.
Define permitted transitions and separate reviewer authority; record acknowledgement before implementation.

records.title: Discover and reconcile repository projects
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Discover registered projects in the configured repository automatically; arbitrary folders are not silently classified as projects.
Repeated scans are idempotent; renamed, removed and inaccessible sources are reported without deleting runtime history.

records.title: Publish conversation-derived plans into MAS-PM
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Architect publishes structured project details and approved plan revisions through an authenticated integration, creating tasks and dependencies without CEO scripts.
Updates preserve active work, evidence and review; ambiguous changes are surfaced instead of silently overwriting.

records.title: Integrate Antigravity agent progress and evidence
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Once the CEO starts Antigravity, assignment, start, progress, blocker, comments, notes and evidence events persist automatically against the correct task.
Authenticated tenant and task ownership enforced; duplicate, replayed and out-of-order events handled; agent claims cannot certify DONE.
Demonstrate the adapter with actual Antigravity execution, not only a simulated producer.

records.title: Repair authenticated board actions
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Remove hard-coded founder_lead caller identity and consume the agreed authenticated identity contract.
Authorized action succeeds; unauthorized action remains denied; errors visible above drawers and stale governance notice corrected.

records.title: Deliver live project, task and activity views
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Board reflects persisted agent events within five seconds on a healthy connection without manual refresh.
Show comments, notes, evidence provenance, blockers and independent review state; visibly report stale/disconnected data and reconnect safely.

records.title: Qualify recovery, isolation and adversarial events
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Restart and reconnect retain project/task history and resume event processing without duplicate tickets or transitions.
Reject cross-tenant writes, forged identity, replay, invalid transitions and fabricated completion evidence; attach actual executed results.

records.title: Prove the CEO-to-agent-to-board workflow
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Use one real approved project: CEO supplies details, architect publishes plan, CEO starts Antigravity once, agents work and board updates automatically.
Capture native browser evidence of progress, comments, evidence and independently reviewed completion; no CEO SQL, import commands, ticket dragging or manual status maintenance.
Independent reviewer accepts the exact candidate; CEO approves rollout and rollback procedure.

records.title: Automate Antigravity branch synchronization and task kickoff
records.reviewer: Independent reviewer distinct from implementation owner; appointment pending
acceptance: Provide an authenticated supported launcher or agent bridge that synchronizes the configured delivery branch and starts dependency-ready Antigravity work without manual IDE pull/start steps.
Discover the actual IDE/runtime integration capability first; document unsupported operations rather than assuming an IDE launch API.
Preserve dirty checkouts; reject unapproved branch changes; prevent duplicate runs and stop on revoked credentials or unresolved conflicts.
Demonstrate real startup, cancellation, restart and progress reporting; retain the manual pickup fallback.
